idea-plugin.name: PII Anonymizer / Repro Sanitizer
idea-plugin.description:
PII Anonymizer / Repro Sanitizer

Need to attach a log, JSON or CSV to a bug report but it contains real PII? Select the text (or the whole file) and run Anonymize PII — every card number, IBAN, US SSN and email is replaced with a valid-synthetic equivalent. Not asterisks: the replacements pass the real checksum (card Luhn, IBAN mod-97), so the repro stays reproducible and the data stays coherent (the same value always maps to the same replacement). 100% offline.

  • Card (PAN) — Luhn-valid → a synthetic test-BIN card.
  • IBAN — ISO 7064 mod-97 valid → a synthetic valid IBAN in the same country.
  • US SSN → a synthetic never-issued test SSN.
  • Email → user…@example.com (RFC 2606 reserved).

Usage: right-click in the editor → Anonymize PII (Kassi), on a selection or the whole file. Platform-only — installs in every IntelliJ-based IDE. A companion to Kassi Test Data and the Secret & Card Leak Guard.

Source, issues & docs: github.com/VadimToptunov/kassi-plugins
